assets.prompt: Newly draw a 440:132 panoramic banner scene from scratch for a Capybara Go 2D mobile game seven-day festival popup. Bright cyan sky, simple blocky blue castle silhouette at right, brown wooden roadside sign at right with a simple unlettered direction arrow. Pale sandy road and grass across bottom. Center-left a cheerful tan capybara wearing a green diagonal sling cloak, arms stretched outward, round muzzle, one simple closed smiling eye, with a few tiny blue sweat/excitement droplets near head. Several chunky round gold coins flying at left/right and one large coin at lower center-right, and a partially cropped faceted purple gem at bottom right. Thick dark cartoon outlines and clean simple flat cel shading. No text, no words, no numbers, no ribbon, no UI controls. Opaque full bleed landscape scene, all pixels newly illustrated.
